description.value: Poster design (this version, a final proof before printing) for the London Underground, advertising the Natural History Museum which can be reached by the railway. Poster features a number of different objects: a pear, a butterfly, fish, shells, and coral. Text in white, blue and black: VISIT YOUR MUSEUMS / NATURAL HISTORY MUSEUM / WEEKDAYS 10 TO 6 / SUNDAYS 2.30 TO 6 / ADMISSION FREE / [London Underground logo] STATION-SOUTH KENSINGTON.
